title: A product review builds the head before serving it, so its dashboard answers
description: GY-3581: a product review of a UI change runs the repository's build step in the review checkout before the head's e2e.serve command, so the reviewer session's served dashboard answers GET / with 200 instead of HTTP 500 for a missing dist/. A failing build ends the launch naming its output tail.

steps.name: product review builds the head before serving it
